system.description:
At 18th level, you have quested and strove, sought glory and victory, and championed your cause. You have attracted a squire to your service, and you have earned a landed title. Whether you choose to found a knightly order or not, ten @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-monsters.Actor.t7raw64ksqor1nt0]{Knights} swear themselves to your cause and offer their fealty.

Armed and equipped as described by the statblock in the Monstrous Menagerie, they provide for their own lifestyle and maintenance. At your command they can form two squads and will fight on your behalf.

If you have heraldry and an order, or are willing to build one, you gain a +1 bonus to your prestige.
